title: TurboAttention: Efficient Attention Approximation for High Throughput LLMs
problem: LLM attention is a dominant inference bottleneck at long context lengths: KV cache consumes massive memory, FlashAttention requires FP16/FP32 (using slow CUDA cores for softmax exponentiation), and existing KV cache compression methods still dequantize to FP16 before attention, negating latency benefits.
motivation: FP32 CUDA cores deliver only ~3% of FP16 Tensor Core throughput. Attention can constitute up to 80% of inference latency at large context lengths. A unified quantized-attention solution that runs entirely on Tensor Cores and removes FP32 exponentiation overhead is needed.
method: TurboAttention combines two innovations: (1) FlashQ — blockwise progressive quantization (BPQ) of Q/K/V to INT8 for FlashAttention-compatible quantized MatMuls, then channel-wise asymmetric INT4/INT2 compression of K/V for cache storage; headwise mixed precision assigns 2-bit quantization to the lowest-priority heads (based on a gap×std priority metric) and 4-bit to the rest. An enhanced KV buffer defers progressive compression every nb=64 steps. (2) SAS (Sparse Activated Softmax) — approximates exponentiation via LUT (integer part) + degree-3 polynomial (decimal part), runs entirely on Tensor Cores in FP16, and sparsifies near-zero attention scores to zero. Together these enable fully INT8 MatMul + FP16 softmax on Tensor Cores.
key_novelty: First unified approach bridging FlashAttention's tiled dataflow with quantization algorithms, enabling fully quantized attention execution (both MatMul and softmax) on GPU Tensor Cores without FP32 CUDA core softmax.
contributions: FlashQ: blockwise progressive quantization of Q/K/V compatible with FlashAttention tiling
Headwise mixed-precision KV cache (INT2/INT4) with priority-based head selection
Enhanced KV cache buffer deferring compression to avoid per-step recompression
SAS: LUT+polynomial softmax approximation eliminating FP32 exponentiation, running on Tensor Cores
End-to-end Triton implementation fusing QKV projection with quantization

metrics.speedup: Up to 1.8x prefill speedup, 1.7x decode speedup vs FlashAttention FP16; up to 2.37x maximum throughput
metrics.accuracy: Near-lossless: avg 60.27% vs 61.89% FP16 baseline on GSM8k/AQuA/BBH across Llama3/Qwen2/Phi-3
metrics.other: KV cache size reduced by over 4.4x; enables 32k context where FP16 OOMs at 4k

limitations: Polynomial softmax approximation introduces small numerical error vs exact softmax
2-bit heads can degrade accuracy on some models; headwise selection requires calibration passes
Implemented in Triton; CUDA kernel would deliver additional speedup (noted by authors)
